# CI/CD and release

## PR checks (GitHub Actions)
| Workflow | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ci.yml` (Server Tests) | On PRs (skips changes that touch only css/js/md/html/csv) and nightly. Python 3.14, Node 24, MariaDB 11.8. `python -m compileall` plus a merge-conflict-marker scan. `.github/helper/install.sh` bootstraps bench, Frappe, ERPNext and payments on the base branch. Then `bench run-parallel-tests --app healthcare`. Coverage goes to Codecov on non-PR runs only. |
| `linters.yml` / `linters.v2.yml` | pre-commit (ruff, ruff-format, prettier, eslint, detect-secrets, pip-audit, yaml/json/toml/ast) plus Frappe semgrep rules and `r/python.lang.correctness` |
| `semantic-commits.yml` | commitlint over the PR commit range |
| `docs_checker.yml` | `feat` PRs must link `/wiki` docs (or say `no-docs`) |
| `codeql.yml` | CodeQL security scan |
| `labeller.yml` | Applies the `needs-tests` label |
| `generate-pot-file.yml` | Regenerates `healthcare/locale/main.pot` |

Mergify merges after ≥1 approving review and green CI. Dependabot updates GitHub Actions weekly.

## Release
- `initiate_release.yml` runs weekly (Tue 09:30 UTC) and opens `version-N-hotfix → version-N` release PRs for N = 14, 15, 16.
- `on_release.yml` runs on push to `version-14|15|16` and calls **semantic-release** (`.releaserc`, angular preset; breaking changes do not trigger a major bump). It rewrites the version in `healthcare/__init__.py`, commits `chore(release): Bumped to Version x.y.z`, and publishes a GitHub release.
- `release_notes.yml` / `.github/release.yml` build the release notes and exclude anything labelled `skip-release-notes` (e.g. Crowdin translation PRs).
- Deployment is by `bench get-app` / `bench update` on sites (or Frappe Cloud). There is no deploy job in this repo.
